51737.author: sbein
51737.body:
This is a backport PR that fixes a FastSim reco-gen jet ordering scheme that can arise with refined collections. This is needed for Run 3 MC production requests using FastSim. The original PR is:

https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51566
51737.title: Fix FastSim NanoAOD jet row links (15_0_X backport)
